title: Protection Against Insulin Resistance in Obesity
brief_summary: The overall goal of this project is to identify factors that "protect" some obese adults from becoming insulin resistant. Identifying mechanisms that help protect some obese adults from developing insulin resistance could lead to novel, targeted therapeutic and/or preventative strategies for obese adults who are insulin resistant.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Body mass index \[BMI\]: 30-40 kg/m2
* Age: 18-45 years
* All women must be pre-menopausal
* Non-exerciser: no regularly planned exercise/physical activity

Exclusion Criteria:

* Weight instability ≥ ±3kg ≥ 6 months
* Medications known to affect lipid and/or glucose metabolism
* Pregnancy or actively breast feeding
